ocr.notes: some errors: belt is 'forty inches' long (not thirty); side plates 3 1/2 inches; excursion fare is 'thirty-two dollars' (not two dollars) and wording 'to take those who wish to see the fight'; 'fistic circles'/'excursionists' misread; omits sentence 'The belt to be given him he has won by stout hardihood and hard knocks.'

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen was to be presented that evening at the Theatre Comique with a $1,000 gold and silver belt from his St. Louis admirers, ahead of his coming fight with Jem Mace near New Orleans.

metadata.notes: masthead reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, April 30, 1870'

facts.fact: Allen was to be presented with a $1,000 gold and silver belt by his St. Louis friends at the Theatre Comique, St. Louis, on the evening of April 30, 1870; it was made under the supervision of Wm. Walsh, who had overseen McCoole's belt
Allen's coming fight with Jem Mace was to take place near New Orleans, with Billy Carroll arranging railroad excursions from St. Louis

notes: Existing fact 021 dates the presentation April 29, 1870; this article says the evening of April 30, and article 034 says it was postponed twice and not yet held by May 5.
